title: Audio alert service with 3-stage alert sounds and voice prompts
description: Implement alerts/audio_service.py to play local synthesized audio tones (beep, double chime, alarm) and voice prompts for each stage using offline audio generation or local playback.
acceptanceCriteria: Generates or provides offline WAV sound clips: Stage 1 beep, Stage 2 alert chime, Stage 3 alarm pattern

Plays designated voice messages: Stage 1 ('Please stay alert. Keep your eyes on the road.'), Stage 2 ('Warning! You may be getting drowsy. Please find a safe place to stop.'), Stage 3 ('Danger! Pull over safely as soon as possible. Do not continue driving while drowsy.')
Provides non-blocking playback so audio does not freeze detection or UI
Gracefully handles missing audio output devices without crashing
Unit tests verify audio service dispatching and mute/volume controls

steps.description: Implement AudioService class and sound generator
steps.details: Create alerts/audio_service.py. Synthesize standard sine-wave WAV files for beep, chime, and siren using standard library wave & math/numpy, storing in assets/audio/.
Use winsound (on Windows) or threading with simple audio playback fallback (e.g. pygame, sounddevice, or web audio trigger) ensuring non-blocking audio dispatch.
Support offline text-to-speech (via pyttsx3 fallback) or pre-recorded clips, matching exact PRD sample text for Stage 1, Stage 2, and Stage 3.
Create tests/test_audio_service.py testing play_stage_alert(), volume/mute settings, and silent mode fallback on headless environments.

technicalNotes: Never crash if OS audio hardware is unavailable (e.g. in headless CI or Docker sandbox).
Ensure sound volume and duration comply with non-startling safety principles from PRD FR-05.
